# 0439: one universal iOS app, its project generated by XcodeGen

The iOS app is one target for iPhone and iPad. Its Xcode project is generated from `clients/swift/ios/project.yml` and not committed, so the spec is the reviewable source and merge conflicts in a `.pbxproj` cannot happen. Bundle id and team are build settings so CI can set them without editing files. The root layout is chosen by horizontal size class through a pure function in `MonitorCore`. Mac-only `.link` and `.checkbox` styles get same-named iOS stand-ins instead of edits at fifteen call sites.
